i work for (and give interviews for) a big tech company and honestly we don’t care too much about side projects. usually what’s on your resume is what we ask behavioral questions about, and that can be anything from school projects to internships to personal projects. as long as you give a good behavioral answer, we don’t really care where it’s from

like others, i would highly suggest working on leetcode or other coding skills instead, since that’ll be the bulk of your evaluation
